SuspendStress: Verify S0ix Residency counter. If the default suspend state is 'freeze', the system suspends to S0ix. When the system suspends to S0ix, bugs in the drivers can keep the cores busy preventing them from entering the highest possible C state. In such case, the S0ix counter does not increase. A successful S0ix suspend should increment the residency counter. If not, fail the test. BUG=chrome-os-partner:62526 TEST=manual, run suspend_stress and make sure the residency counter is read properly. Change-Id: Ia78eaedee6f840fafa0861e5911132590f812585 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/437615 Commit-Ready: Ravi Chandra Sadineni <ravisadineni@chromium.org> Tested-by: Ravi Chandra Sadineni <ravisadineni@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Todd Broch <tbroch@chromium.org>
